tasks.label: Qt: Configure (qmake)
args: QT_QMAKE=""; if command -v qmake6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_QMAKE="$(command -v qmake6)"; elif command -v qmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then QT_QMAKE="$(command -v qmake)"; elif [[ -x "/opt/homebrew/opt/qt/bin/qmake" ]]; then QT_QMAKE="/opt/homebrew/opt/qt/bin/qmake"; fi; if [[ -z "$QT_QMAKE" ]]; then echo "qmake not found. Install Qt or add it to PATH."; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "build/musicplayer" && cd "build/musicplayer" && "$QT_QMAKE" "../../project/source/MusicPlayer.pro"

tasks.label: Qt: Run
args: if [[ -x "dist/MusicPlayer.app/Contents/MacOS/MusicPlayer" ]]; then "dist/MusicPlayer.app/Contents/MacOS/MusicPlayer"; elif [[ -x "build/musicplayer/MusicPlayer.app/Contents/MacOS/MusicPlayer" ]]; then "build/musicplayer/MusicPlayer.app/Contents/MacOS/MusicPlayer"; else echo "Build output not found. Run Qt: Build first."; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Qt: Clean
args: if [[ -f "build/musicplayer/Makefile" ]]; then make -C "build/musicplayer" clean; else echo "Nothing to clean."; fi; rm -rf "dist/MusicPlayer.app"
